subject: MERF kickoff — real-time radiance fields in the browser
body:
Hi team,

Kicking off MERF productization. The core asset: our open-source MERF work renders large-scale unbounded scenes in real time in a browser by cutting radiance-field memory with a sparse feature grid plus high-resolution 2D feature planes, and a contraction function that keeps ray-box intersection efficient for unbounded scenes. The product target is an embeddable scene viewer for partner demos.

Milestones (window through 07-20):
- 05-15: JAX training pipeline reproduced on the mipnerf360 dataset, quality parity with the paper.
- 06-19: baking pipeline hardened — the lossless procedure that converts the trained parameterization into the real-time model — with automated quality checks.
- 07-10: embeddable viewer demo for the Launch Review Board.

Jelena owns staffing/compute; Yara is TL. Compute ask early, please — training these scenes is not cheap.

Zofia
